hero.description1: Yarowa AG is a Swiss InsurTech platform with deep roots in the insurance industry, operating at scale across core insurance workflows in highly regulated environments. Its platform is shaped by years of close collaboration with insurers and real-world production use.
hero.description2: True Aim AG is a spinout from Yarowa, established to focus specifically on auditable, regulation-ready AI for insurance, combining proven industry expertise with purpose-built technology for transparent, enterprise deployment.

distribution.title: Direct Insurer Distribution
distribution.description: Access to an established network of insurer relationships across Switzerland and Europe. A proven distribution channel for enterprise software.

delivery.title: Enterprise Delivery Experience
delivery.description: Yarowa brings deep enterprise delivery experience. From procurement through implementation, their methodology accelerates time-to-value for insurer clients.

platform.title: Swiss InsurTech Platform
platform.description: A Swiss-based technology platform purpose-built for the insurance industry. Yarowa's infrastructure and market knowledge complement True Aim's decisioning capabilities.

vision.title: Aligned Vision
vision.description: Both True Aim and Yarowa share the conviction that insurance needs transparent, auditable technology. This strategic alignment drives our joint go-to-market approach.

cta.heading: See Our Products in Action
cta.description: Discover how our partnership delivers auditable claims automation to insurers.

hero.description1: True Aim's core technology is supported through a competitive research grant awarded by Innosuisse, Switzerland's national innovation agency. The grant reflects formal, national-level validation of the technical approach and research programme behind True Aim's work in auditable AI.
hero.description2: The funding supports applied research into transparent, controllable and regulation-ready AI systems for highly regulated industries, with a clear focus on measurable outcomes and real-world deployment.

govValidation.title: Official Government Validation
govValidation.description: Innosuisse is the Swiss Confederation's official innovation agency, providing federal endorsement for research and development projects with commercial potential.

excellence.title: Competitive Excellence
excellence.description: Innosuisse grants are awarded through rigorous selection criteria. Receiving funding demonstrates the technical merit and market viability of True Aim's neuro-symbolic approach.

priority.title: National Strategic Priority
priority.description: The grant reflects Switzerland's national commitment to advancing trustworthy AI in regulated industries. True Aim is at the forefront of this initiative.

zhawCollab.title: ZHAW Collaboration
zhawCollab.description: The research programme is conducted in partnership with ZHAW (School of Engineering, Institute of Applied IT, Centre for AI) and is led by Dr. Dandolo Flumini.

grantDetails.label: Innovation Funding
grantDetails.title: Innosuisse Innovation Project Funding
grantDetails.description: Non-dilutive funding from the Swiss Confederation to advance neuro-symbolic AI for deterministic claims decisioning in regulated industries.

cta.heading: Learn More About Our Technology
cta.description: Discover how Innosuisse-backed innovation powers our claims decisioning engine.

hero.description1: Parts of True Aim's innovative technology is developed in collaboration with ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences, one of Switzerland's leading applied research universities, recognised for deep-tech research in AI, data science and engineering with a strong focus on real-world deployment.
hero.description2: The work is supported through Innosuisse innovation funding, with ZHAW as the formal research partner and True Aim as the industry implementation partner, advancing transparent and regulation-ready neuro-symbolic AI for highly regulated industries.

neuroSymbolic.title: Neuro-Symbolic AI
neuroSymbolic.description: Combining the flexibility of neural networks with the precision of symbolic reasoning. Our research focuses on making AI decisions deterministic and fully explainable.

logicExtraction.title: Logic Extraction & Automation
logicExtraction.description: Developing methods to extract formal logic from natural-language policy documents and transform it into computable decision rules.

deterministic.title: Deterministic Decisioning
deterministic.description: Ensuring that identical inputs always produce identical outputs, with complete traceability from decision to source text. Critical for regulatory compliance.

applied.title: Applied Industry Research
applied.description: Bridging academic research and real-world insurance operations. Testing and validating approaches against actual claims data and policy documents.

researchGroup.heading: About the Research Group
researchGroup.description: The research is hosted within ZHAW's <schoolOfEngineering>School of Engineering</schoolOfEngineering>, specifically the <init>Institute of Applied Information Technology (InIT)</init> and the <cai>Centre for Artificial Intelligence (CAI)</cai>.

dandolo.name: Dr. Dandolo Flumini
dandolo.bio: Original developer of the MIRA technology. PhD in Mathematics and Computer Science. Leads True Aim's Innosuisse-funded Innovation Project.

lukas.name: Dr. Lukas Lichtensteiger
lukas.bio: Harvard alumnus, serial entrepreneur and CTO. ZHAW researcher in AI and robotics. True Aim technical advisor.

cta.heading: See the Research in Action
cta.description: Discover how our ZHAW-rooted technology delivers auditable claims decisions.

hero.description1: Swiss InsurTech Hub is Switzerland's leading network for insurance innovation, bringing together insurers, startups and technology partners to accelerate digital transformation across the industry. The platform fosters collaboration, knowledge sharing and access to a broad ecosystem of forward-thinking organisations.
hero.description2: True Aim AG is a member of the Swiss InsurTech Hub, actively contributing to the advancement of auditable, regulation-ready AI in insurance, and engaging with leading industry participants to shape the future of claims automation and decisioning.

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem Access
ecosystem.description: Access to a broad network of insurers, partners and innovators across Switzerland and Europe. A strong platform for collaboration, partnerships and market visibility.

collaboration.title: Industry Collaboration
collaboration.description: Facilitates collaboration between incumbents and emerging technology providers. Enables practical engagement on real-world use cases and innovation initiatives.

platform.title: Innovation Platform
platform.description: A recognised Swiss platform dedicated to advancing insurance innovation. Supports knowledge exchange, thought leadership and industry alignment.

vision.title: Aligned Vision
vision.description: Both True Aim and the Swiss InsurTech Hub share a focus on advancing modern, transparent and compliant insurance technology. This alignment supports long-term innovation and responsible adoption of AI.

cta.heading: See Our Products in Action
cta.description: Discover how our partnerships deliver auditable claims automation to insurers.
